svg.title: Wallpaper follows the theme
svg.desc: Animated diagram. Left: Omarchy in the VM. Its theme menu switches the theme from Rose Pine to Tokyo Night, then to Everforest, then back to Rose Pine; the background, bar and window borders change each time. Each switch sends the background over OmacVM Bridge to the Mac as a small packet labelled wallpaper. Right: the notched MacBook's desktop, with its menu bar and Dock, changes its wallpaper to the same background. A small thumbnail underneath shows macOS's own, unchanged lock screen (clock, generic user picture and password field) in front of the new wallpaper.
svg.text: the Mac's wallpaper follows your Omarchy theme
